children: Charles River announced a refreshed Pathway to Purpose strategy, reaffirmed 2026 guidance at the upper end of prior ranges, and set long-term financial targets through 2030.
Announced Pathway to Purpose strategy to modernize operations, strengthen scientific portfolio, and enhance client experience.
Reaffirmed 2026 guidance; expects revenue and non-GAAP EPS at the upper ends of prior ranges due to favorable biopharma demand.
Introduced 2030 targets: 5%–7% organic revenue CAGR (2027–2030) and ~24% non-GAAP operating margin.
Plans Create the Future program to deliver over $300m cumulative savings (2027–2030) via automation and efficiencies.
Targets bioanalysis organic growth to a high-single-digit CAGR to about $450m in 2030 and expands Apollo client platform (18,000+ users).
